author: Pavlo
body:
Hi guys, I haven't made a new map in a while, so I decided it's time for something new!
I've put aside fixing up my last 2 maps for a bit, but I will get back to them later :P

Anyways, as the title says, I'd like your guys feedback and what I should add/remove or change to improve it! I'm currently unsure of the load-out or team names. If you can think of a better map name, please suggest one :P

Here are some pictures, to see the full gallery, click Here

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I think it looks fantastic!

I love the jungle ruins/temple theme, and the blocks work well together :P
It should play nicely as well with the giant bridge. I'm not a big fan of jungle terrain but, by the way you built it, it'll be perfectly okay.

+1 :)
